title: Flashcard Creator — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Generates flashcards from notes and textbooks for active recall practice. The Flashcard Creator turns notes and textbook passages into flashcards for active recall. It extracts key terms, dates, definitions, and relationships, writes a clear question for the front and a concise answer for the back, and organizes cards into decks by chapter or topic. Cards are deduplicated and balanced so no fact appears twice.
capabilities: Generate question/answer cards from notes and textbook text
Build decks organized by chapter, topic, or exam
Extract terms, definitions, dates, and cause-effect pairs
Deduplicate cards and balance deck coverage
Export decks for review sessions
